title: Build system: C library compilation (Nuklear, sokol, stb_truetype)
acceptance_criteria: Makefile downloads or references Nuklear single-header (nuklear.h)
Makefile downloads or references sokol headers (sokol_app.h, sokol_gfx.h)
C libraries compile to static library (.a) or object files (.o)
C compilation uses -fPIC for position-independent code
C compilation uses -Os for size optimization
All three libraries compile without errors on Linux x86_64
deliverables: Makefile (updated with C library build rules)
